g.text: Science weak modulation — fixed pump versus static-resonance control

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c4c4c

g.text: Blue: frozen common-frequency bath. Open markers: local finite-window memory at the same calibrated pump.
Blue Im points: half-drive-locked poles; grey: unlocked. Open memory markers include frequency shifts; they are not locked.
The right column is a separate pump-frequency control. Its weak instability is sensitive to the frequency-dependent bath closure.
